output_list.criticism: The mint function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The minting function mint(address _to, uint256 _amount) canMint internal returns (bool) { _amount = _amount.div(10**10); if(totalSupply.add(_amount)<maxTokenSupply){ super.mint(_to,_amount.mul(75).div(100)); super.mint(address(beneficiary),_amount.mul(25).div(100)); return true; } else{ return false; } return true; } The issue is that the _amount is divided by 10**10, but the maxTokenSupply is not. If the totalSupply + _amount overflows, it will not be detected, allowing the minting of unlimited tokens.
